related_questions.question: How do I get in touch with the Canadian Embassy?

text_blocks.snippet: To contact the Canadian Embassy or a specific Canadian office, you can use the online web form, find an office location, or call. You can find contact information for Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) through their website. For general inquiries, you can also contact Global Affairs Canada through their online form.
snippet_highlighted_words: use the online web form, find an office location, or call

list.title: 1. Identify the appropriate contact method:
list.snippet: Depending on your need, you can choose to contact IRCC or Global Affairs Canada.
For IRCC: Visit the Canada.ca website and navigate to the "Contact" section.
For Global Affairs Canada: Use the online contact form available on their website.
Web form: Use the online form provided by IRCC or Global Affairs Canada.
Phone: Call the relevant number provided on their website.
Find an office: Locate the nearest Canadian office or embassy using the "Find an office" tool on Canada.ca.

list.title: 4. Consider calling the Client Support Centre:
list.snippet: For immigration-related questions, you may also contact the Client Support Centre.
